def: the crown of the head (as the part most bowed)
kjv: crown (of the head), pate, scalp, top of the head.

words.word: and on the crown of the head
and upon the top of the head
even to the crown of his head
and the crown of the head

occurrences.text: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.
words: and on the crown of the head

occurrences.text: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren.
words: and upon the top of the head

occurrences.text: But in all Israel there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty: from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him.
words: even to the crown of his head

occurrences.text: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.
Therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the Lord will discover their secret parts.

They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force: but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.
words: and the crown of the head
